text:
**STEP 1 - Scene:** This is a healthy lunch plate. It has mashed or roasted orange sweet potato (or squash), tuna salad with celery and red onion, shredded raw carrots and a few avocado slices.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** The plate is a square white dinner plate, about 25 cm per side. Because it is square, I used side × side instead of the circle formula: area ≈ 625 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:**
- Sweet potato mash
- Tuna salad (tuna, celery, onion, some mayo)
- Shredded carrots
- Avocado slices

**STEP 4 - Area:**

| Item | Share of plate |
|---|---|
| Sweet potato | ~10% |
| Tuna salad | ~22% |
| Carrots | ~18% |
| Avocado | ~4% |
| **Total covered** | **~54%** (consistent with the visible empty rim and space) |

**STEP 5 - Volume:**

| Item | Area | Height | Gross volume |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sweet potato | 62 cm² | 3 cm | 187 ml |
| Tuna salad | 137 cm² | 2 cm | 274 ml |
| Carrots | 112 cm² | 1.5 cm | 169 ml |
| Avocado | 25 cm² | 1.5 cm | 37 ml |

**STEP 6 - Grams:**
- Sweet potato: 187 ml × 0.8 (chunky mash) = 150 g
- Tuna salad: 274 ml × 0.85 = 233 g
- Carrots: 169 ml × 0.45 (loosely shredded, so below the usual cut-veg range) = 76 g
- Avocado: 37 ml × 0.9 = 33 g

**STEP 7 - Energy:**
- Sweet potato: 150 g × 90 kcal/100 g = 135 kcal
- Tuna salad: 233 g × 140 kcal/100 g = 326 kcal
- Carrots: 76 g × 41 kcal/100 g = 31 kcal
- Avocado: 33 g × 160 kcal/100 g = 53 kcal

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** The total is about 492 g and 545 kcal. That is plausible for a moderately filled dinner plate with a generous scoop of tuna salad.
